feat: Implement IntelGraph Maestro production readiness

This commit introduces the complete set of features and configurations required
to bring the IntelGraph Maestro orchestrator to a production-ready state.

Key changes include:
- Comprehensive Kubernetes deployment configurations for dev, UAT, and prod environments.
- Golden CI/CD pipeline with image signing, SBOM generation, and security scanning.
- New Maestro UI components for workflow dashboard and task monitoring.
- Enhanced Makefiles for one-click deployments and operational tasks.
- Integration of OIDC authentication, canary deployments, and SLO monitoring.
- Gatekeeper policies for supply chain security.
- Reference workflows (hello-world, hello-case) and go-live documentation.
